title: Practitioner Voices Summit: How Teachers Evaluate AI Tools through Deliberative Sensemaking

bias_targets.target: General societal and algorithmic bias (Stereotypes and Fairness)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of K-12 educator-generated rubrics and criteria, specifically identifying how teachers evaluate AI outputs for minimizing stereotype reinforcement, creator blind spots, and ensuring parity across student subgroups.

Observational analysis and qualitative coding of educators evaluating AI-generated instructional materials (e.g., math word problems) for cultural relevance, authentic language use, and assets-based representation of diverse student populations.
